security_notes: Never ask for or store the Orange Money/Afrimoney PIN in MatMove.
The Exchange endpoint must validate the order, use a stable idempotency key and return within Monime's required timeout.
Only the verified Monime Payment object and durable signed webhook can mark the order paid.
This draft is not guaranteed to be directly importable until Monime confirms the live Flow JSON schema and template field names.
